title: Qwen-Audio-Jev: A Unified Interface for Audio Decisions
abstract: arXiv:2610.21614v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large audio language models (LALMs) have made substantial progress in audio understanding. However, in high-throughput applications requiring frequent selection, judgment, and scoring, autoregressive text generation introduces additional computational overhead and response latency. To address this limitation, we introduce Qwen-Audio-Jev by augmenting Qwen-Audio-3.1-ASR-Flash-Next with a dedicated Jev decision head. The model unifies selection, binary judgment, and scoring through three decision primitives: CHOICE, NOUL, and SCORE. Given audio, a natural-language question, and an explicit answer specification, it directly produces a task-conditioned probability distribution or a numerical score through typed decision readouts. Evaluation across 18 labeled configurations covers all three primitives: for CHOICE, Qwen-Audio-Jev achieves accuracies of 78.70% on MMAU-mini and 84.06% on MMSU; for NOUL, it achieves an equal error rate of 6.50%

translated_title: Qwen-Audio-Jev：面向音频决策的统一接口
translated_abstract: 大音频语言模型（LALMs）在音频理解方面已取得长足进展。然而，在需要频繁进行选择、判断和评分的高吞吐量应用中，自回归文本生成会带来额外的计算开销和响应延迟。为解决这一局限，我们通过为 Qwen-Audio-3.1-ASR-Flash-Next 增配专用的 Jev 决策头，推出了 Qwen-Audio-Jev。该模型通过三种决策原语（CHOICE、NOUL 和 SCORE）将选择、二元判断和评分统一到一个框架中。给定音频、自然语言问题以及明确的答案规范，它可以通过类型化的决策读取直接产生任务条件下的概率分布或数值评分。在覆盖全部三种原语的 18 个带标注配置上的评估显示：在 CHOICE 任务上，Qwen-Audio-Jev 在 MMAU-mini 上达到 78.70% 的准确率，在 MMSU 上达到 84.06%；在 NOUL 任务上，其等错误率为 6.50%。
tldr: 该论文提出 Qwen-Audio-Jev，通过专用 Jev 决策头，以 CHOICE、NOUL、SCORE 三种决策原语直接输出选择、判断和评分结果，取代自回归文本生成，从而显著降低高吞吐量音频决策任务中的计算开销与响应延迟。
en_tdlr: Qwen-Audio-Jev augments an audio language model with a dedicated decision head that unifies selection, binary judgment, and scoring through three decision primitives (CHOICE, NOUL, SCORE), directly producing probability distributions or numerical scores to eliminate the computational overhead and latency of autoregressive text generation in high-throughput audio decision tasks.
